description: Upload and attach a transient image asset specifically to a template draft canvas. Call while authoring a template draft in canvas studio to place background or sample imagery. Do NOT use for general workspace media library assets, logos, and photos (use import_image instead). Requires draft owner authorization and idempotencyKey. Idempotent: duplicate uploads with identical idempotencyKey return the existing asset. Returns created template image asset with imageId, dimensions, and public CDN preview URL.

creator.description: Optional author or photographer attribution name.

draftId.description: The unique template draft ID this image is attached to.

externalId.description: Optional external asset ID from provider.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique idempotency key to prevent duplicate image creation.

provider.description: Asset origin provider: pinterest | unsplash | pexels | user_upload | generated

rightsStatus.description: Rights ownership status: rights_unknown | licensed_for_publish | user_owned | generated

searchQuery.description: Optional search keyword that discovered this image.

sourceUrl.description: Optional source URL if fetched from web.

name: import_template_image
title: Import template image
